required_setup: PAX at final output; both paths open unless prompted. Wire OUT1 to IN1 and OUT2 to IN2 as voltage references. 'both' runs the complete diagnostic for both actuators automatically.

effective_config.bench_pax_location: In front of NPBS 1, C port
effective_config.bench_voltage_chain: Red Pitaya (0-1 V command) -> Thorlabs MDT690 -> piezo
effective_config.bench_notes: V_pi expectation only; verify channel and measured driver gain before calibration.

acquisition.time_origin: host_monotonic experiment origin; not persisted as an absolute clock
acquisition.synchronization: RP sample times use the FPGA scope trigger/current 125-MHz counters mapped into host monotonic time by a bracketed counter read. A host request/completion bracket is retained per capture and used only as an explicit fallback. PAX elapsed_s is the host request/receive midpoint minus the configured empirical latency. Raw timestamps, uncertainties, counter values, and capture gaps are retained.
acquisition.fpga_counter_scale_uncertainty_assumptio: 100 ppm plus half a raw scope interval
acquisition.pax_latency_correction_basis: Empirical 2026-09-29 cross-sweep lag sensitivity: branch separation was minimized with PAX records associated 0.10--0.13 s before the transaction midpoint. This is a timing calibration, not an instrument-provided timestamp.

reference_validation.criteria: gain 0.5..1.5; absolute phase <=45 deg; residual <=max(0.02 V, 10% measured amplitude)
